overall_strategy_summary: JP Morgan is the world's largest bank and a clear technology leader in financial services. The firm spends $18B annually on technology ($2B specifically on AI). Kinexys blockchain platform has processed $1.5T+ since 2020 ($2B/day). Key platforms: Kinexys (payments, collateral, fund tokenization), Onyx/MONY tokenized MMF, TCN ($300B repo volume). Broader strategy: AI deployment at massive scale, cloud transformation, consumer banking (Chase), investment banking leadership, asset/wealth management. Jamie Dimon publicly skeptical of crypto custody but deeply committed to blockchain infrastructure and tokenization.

people.team_structure: Kinexys as dedicated blockchain business unit. $18B annual technology budget ($2B on AI). Multiple Kinexys product lines: Digital Payments, Digital Assets, Labs, Fund Flow. Cross-divisional across Payments, AM, Private Bank, Securities.
people.leadership_commitment: Extremely strong on technology and tokenization. CEO publicly skeptical of crypto custody but deeply committed to blockchain infrastructure. Largest technology spender among banks.
people.workforce_signals: ~310,000 employees. $18B technology budget. 12,000+ engineers with AI copilots. Hundreds of autonomous AI coding agents planned.

analyst_judgment.strategy_posture: Undisputed global leader in bank-led blockchain infrastructure. Production-grade at scale.
analyst_judgment.likely_objectives: Dominate institutional blockchain payments and tokenization. Create industry-standard infrastructure via Kinexys and Canton Network.
analyst_judgment.not_prioritizing: Crypto custody (CEO explicitly declined), retail crypto trading, DeFi exposure.
analyst_judgment.strongest_areas: Transaction volume ($1.5T+), product breadth (payments, collateral, funds, PE), technology maturity, ecosystem partnerships, global reach.
analyst_judgment.weakest_areas: No crypto custody (deliberate choice). Limited public chain exposure (testing only). JPMD is not a stablecoin.
analyst_judgment.build_vs_buy_hypothesis: Predominantly build. Kinexys fully proprietary. Selective partnerships for ecosystem expansion.

process.front_office: JPMD deposit token for institutional 24/7 payments. MONY tokenized MMF ($5M min for HNW, $25M for institutions). TCN for collateral management. Kinexys Fund Flow for PE fund automation.
process.middle_office: Private permissioned blockchain with enterprise-grade compliance. Third-party connectivity via APIs. Integration with existing JP Morgan systems.
process.back_office: Kinexys platform: EVM-compatible blockchain. Canton Network integration planned. Ondo Finance/Chainlink DvP testing on public chains. Citco partnership for fund admin.
process.operating_model_maturity: Industrialized. $1.5T+ processed. Production across payments, collateral, and fund tokenization.
process.regulatory_adaptation: US-focused with global reach. GENIUS Act awareness. Working within existing banking frameworks. Not pursuing crypto custody (CEO decision).

products.name: Kinexys Digital Payments (JPMD)
products.description: First bank-issued USD deposit token. 24/7 cross-border payments. $2B/day average processing. Being brought to Canton Network.

products.name: Tokenized Collateral Network (TCN)
products.description: $300B+ in intraday repo trading volume. Tokenized MMF shares as collateral. BlackRock and Fidelity International participants.

products.name: MONY (My OnChain Net Yield Fund)
products.description: First JP Morgan tokenized MMF on Kinexys Digital Assets. $1M minimum investment. Redemption via cash or USDC.

products.name: Kinexys Fund Flow
products.description: Blockchain tool for PE fund distribution and servicing. Real-time settlement. First transaction with Citco.

product.revenue_intent: Payment fees, custody and servicing fees, competitive moat in institutional payments, efficiency gains.
product.buy_vs_build: Primarily build. Kinexys is proprietary. Selective partnerships (Ondo, Chainlink, Digital Asset/Canton).

major_initiatives.name: Ondo Finance/Chainlink DvP test (first public chain transaction)
